title.narrative: Towards the sustainability of the national response to HIV - Paraguay (01-Mar-2018-28-Feb-2021)

description.narrative: Paraguay, HIV, Centro de Información y Recursos para el Desarrollo (CIRD)This program has the following goals: Contributing to reducing HIV transmission in key populations. Decentralizing care and prevention for HIV, STIs and TB with quality standards in priority regions. The objectives of this program are: Reduce the shortfall in HIV diagnosis among the key population. Reduce the gap between estimated population and enrollment by the third year. Improve quality and speed of the notification of HIV diagnosis, integrated with the surveillance system. Ensure treatment with ARV for TB patients diagnosed with HIV, in line with protocols. Expand coverage of care and prevention services for HIV, STIs and TB in the priority regions
